title: Product Management — Create and Edit a Product
purpose: Add a product profile to QMAS so you can attach documents, compliance data, testing and eFiling to it.
overview: Open **Product Management** and click **+ New Product**.
**Product Profile**: fill in product details, then choose a supplier. Shipping information, factory and additional info are optional.
**Related Product** (optional): link related products, then click **Done**.
The product appears at the top of the Product Management list. Open it to see the product profile.
To change it later, open the product, click **⋮** next to the name, then **Edit product**.

body: In the left menu, open **Product Management**. Click **+ New Product** at the top right. To add many products at once, use **Import Product**.

body.caption: Product Management list with Import Product and + New Product at the top right.

body: The **Add new product** wizard opens. Under **1. Product Details**, fill in:

list: **Long Descriptions** (optional): purpose, materials and internal parts such as batteries or stuffing.

body: In **Select Category**, search by name (for example “drinkware”), click the category, then click **Add category**.

body.caption: Selected categories show as dark chips at the top. “1 selected” appears next to Add category.

body: Under **2. Supplier**, choose **My supplier list** and click **Select supplier**, or choose **New supplier** to add one here.
In the pop-up, click **Select** on one supplier, then **Confirm**.

body.caption: Select 1 Supplier — you can link one supplier per product.

body: The supplier card appears. Use **Change Supplier** to pick another one, or **Edit this profile** to update the supplier.

body.caption: Selected supplier, followed by 3. Shipping Information (optional).

list: **Shipping Information**: size, weight, tolerance and barcode for the selling unit, inner carton and outer carton.
**Additional Info**: choose a **Buyer** (or **Add buyer**) and upload up to 30 **product photos** (JPG, JPEG, PNG).

body.caption: Factory and Additional Info at the bottom of step 1, then Next.

body: Product linkage helps you manage compliance reports. For example, link a raw material or an assortment to several end products. Click **Select related product**, or skip this step. Click **Done**.
QMAS shows “Product added” and returns to the Product Management list. The new product is at the top.

body.caption: The new product at the top of the list.

body: Click the product to open its profile. From the left menu of the profile you can manage **Document**, **Shipping Detail**, **Compliance Data**, **Quality Requirement**, **AI Risk Screening**, **CPSC eFiling** and **Packaging Detail**.

table: Opens the same wizard with your saved details. Change them, then click Next and Done.
Starts a Product Testing order for this product.
Creates a new product with the same details.

body.caption: The ⋮ menu on the product profile.
Edit product profile — the same steps as creating a product.

tips: Search the list before you create a product so you don’t add a duplicate.
Shipping information is optional when you create the product. You can add it later from **Shipping Detail** on the profile.
faq: How do I create a new product in QMAS?
Go to Product Management (https://qmas.icw.io/product/list), click + New Product, fill in Product Profile, then click Next and Done. Direct link: https://qmas.icw.io/add-product
How do I edit a product?
Open the product from the Product Management list, click ⋮ next to the product name, then Edit product.
Can I add many products at once?
Yes. Click Import Product on the Product Management list.
Where do I submit eFiling or add compliance data for a product?
Open the product profile and use CPSC eFiling or Compliance Data in its left menu.
